mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCESS_AUDIT_LOG (VIEWER_USER_ID, TARGET_USER_ID, ACCESS_REASON, ACCESSED_RESOURCE, CLIENT_IP, ACCESSED_AT) VALUES (#{viewerUserId}, #{targetUserId}, #{reason}, #{resource}, #{clientIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_ID AS requestId, TRAD_SCORE AS tradScore, ALT_SCORE AS altScore, ALT_GRADE_BAND_CODE AS altGradeBandCode, ASSESSED_AT AS assessedAt FROM ASSESSMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ASSESSED_AT DESC, ASSESSMENT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, BASE_DATE AS baseDate, CREDIT_HISTORY_DAYS AS creditHistoryDays, DELINQ_COUNT_12M AS delinqCount12m, NEW_LOAN_COUNT_3M AS newLoanCount3m, CARD_LIMIT_AMT AS cardLimitAmt, CARD_MONTHLY_SPEND_AMT AS cardMonthlySpendAmt, CARD_UTIL_PCT AS cardUtilPct, CASH_ADVANCE_MONTHS AS cashAdvanceMonths, PRIVATE_LENDER_LOAN_BALANCE_AMT AS privateLenderLoanBalanceAmt, SOURCE_CODE AS sourceCode FROM USER_CREDIT_PROFILE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY BASE_DATE DESC, CREDIT_PROFILE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BILL_MONTH) FROM USER_TELECOM_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS telecom, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BILL_MONTH) FROM USER_UTILITY_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS utility, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_EASYPAY_USAGE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS easypay, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_SOCIAL_INSURANCE_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND INSURANCE_TYPE_CODE = 'NATIONAL_PENSION') AS nationalPension, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BASE_MONTH) FROM USER_SOCIAL_INSURANCE_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND INSURANCE_TYPE_CODE = 'HEALTH_INSURANCE') AS healthInsurance FROM DUAL

SELECT l.ACCESSED_AT AS accessedAt, v.LOGIN_ID AS viewerLoginId, l.TARGET_USER_ID AS targetUserId, t.LOGIN_ID AS targetLoginId, t.NAME_ENC AS targetNameEnc, l.ACCESS_REASON AS reason, l.ACCESSED_RESOURCE AS accessedResource FROM ACCESS_AUDIT_LOG l LEFT JOIN APP_USER v ON v.USER_ID = l.VIEWER_USER_ID LEFT JOIN APP_USER t ON t.USER_ID = l.TARGET_USER_ID ORDER BY l.ACCESSED_AT DESC, l.AUDIT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
